teaser: A composer's synth video of Journey's Separate Ways, explained frame by frame, and why describing work as you make it matters.
core_idea: A three-camera video of the Separate Ways synth part means little to most viewers. Explained by voice and checked by an agent, it becomes a page: a Bluetooth MIDI keyboard, a Behringer Pro-800 copying the Prophet-600, chorus and delay, and decay turned down live so the delay repeats a staccato chord. The checking corrected two remembered details, and a side remark became a second article. Capturing work at the moment of creation is the first step to publishing it.
